usage: If + had + 过去分词，would have + 过去分词。表与过去事实相反的虚拟。
examples: If I had studied harder, I would have passed.
If she had known, she would have come.
I wouldn't have been late if I had left earlier.
mistakes: if 从句用 would have
主句用过去式而非 would have done
compare: 第三条件 vs. 第二条件：过去虚拟 vs. 现在虚拟。

usage: if 从句与主句时间不一致，如 if 过去 + 主句现在。
examples: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
If I were rich, I would have bought that house.
If you had taken the map, we wouldn't be lost.
mistakes: 时态混用导致逻辑不清
全句用同一条件结构
compare: 混合条件用于过去原因影响现在结果。

usage: wish + 过去式（现在），wish + had done（过去），wish + would/could（将来）。
examples: I wish I knew the answer.
I wish I had studied harder.
I wish you would stop talking.
mistakes: wish 后接真实时态
I wish I was  vs. were（正式用 were）
compare: wish vs. hope：wish 表难实现，hope 表可能实现。

usage: 各种时态的 be + 过去分词：is being done, has been done, will be done 等。
examples: The project is being discussed.
The house has been sold.
The work will have been finished by tomorrow.
mistakes: 进行时被动态结构错误
漏掉助动词 be 的相应时态
compare: 主动 vs. 被动：根据强调重点选择。

usage: 命令/建议转述：tell/ask/order/advise/warn + sb + to do； suggest doing。
examples: He told me to wait.
She suggested going to the cinema.
They warned us not to go out.
mistakes: suggest 后接 to do（应为 doing）
ask 后接宾语从句时结构错误
compare: say/tell vs. ask/order/advise 的转述结构不同。

usage: who/which/whose/where 引导，用逗号隔开，提供附加信息。
examples: My brother, who lives in Tokyo, is a teacher.
Paris, which is the capital of France, is beautiful.
The book, whose cover is red, is mine.
mistakes: 非限定性从句用 that
漏掉逗号
compare: 限定性 vs. 非限定性：限定性必要，非限定性补充。

usage: -ing/-ed 分词短语作状语，表时间、原因、条件、结果。
examples: Walking home, I met an old friend.
Feeling tired, she went to bed early.
Broken into pieces, the vase was useless.
mistakes: 分词逻辑主语与主句不一致
误用 having + 过去分词
compare: 分词短语 vs. 完整从句：更简洁，但需主语一致。

meaning: 使役结构 have/get sth done
usage: have/get + 宾语 + 过去分词。表让别人做某事。
examples: I had my hair cut.
We need to get the car repaired.
She got the report translated.
mistakes: have sth done 与 have done 混淆
get 后接动词原形
compare: have sth done 表他人完成，do sth oneself 表亲自做。

usage: It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 句子其余部分。
examples: It was John who broke the window.
It was yesterday that I saw her.
It is in Paris that they met.
mistakes: 强调句用 when/where 替代 that（非正式可接受，但标准用 that）
被强调部分位置错误
compare: 强调句 vs. 普通句：强调句突出某一成分。

usage: 否定副词开头或 only + 状语开头时部分倒装：助动词提前。
examples: Never have I seen such a beautiful sight.
Only when I arrived did I understand.
Hardly had I left when it started raining.
mistakes: 倒装时未提前助动词
非否定副词开头也倒装
compare: 倒装 vs. 正常语序：倒装强调或正式。

usage: 表示建议、要求、命令的从句中用 (should) + 动词原形。常见于 suggest, insist, recommend, demand。
examples: I suggest that he (should) go early.
It is important that she be informed.
They demanded that he leave.
mistakes: 从句中用真实时态（*I suggest that he goes* 美式可接受，但正式用 should go / go）
should 后加 to
compare: 英式常用 should do，美式常直接用动词原形。

usage: will be + V-ing。表将来某时正在进行的动作。
examples: This time tomorrow, I'll be flying to Paris.
At 8 pm, she will be cooking dinner.
They will be waiting for us.
mistakes: will be 后接动词原形
与将来完成时混淆
compare: 将来进行时 vs. will do：将来某时正在 vs. 将来发生。

usage: will have + 过去分词。表将来某时之前完成的动作。
examples: By next year, I will have graduated.
She will have finished by 6 pm.
They will have left before you arrive.
mistakes: will have 后接动词原形
时间状语用 since 而非 by
compare: 将来完成时 vs. 将来完成进行时：是否强调持续。

usage: 避免重复，省略已知部分。常见于比较、回答、并列句。
examples: I like tea, but she prefers coffee. (省略 likes)
He can run faster than I can. (省略 run)
Yes, I will. (省略 come)
mistakes: 省略导致句子不完整或歧义
比较结构中省略 than I do 的 do
compare: 省略 vs. 完整句：口语更常省略。

usage: however, therefore, furthermore, on the other hand, nevertheless 等连接观点。
examples: It was raining. However, we went out.
She's smart. Therefore, she got the job.
On the other hand, it's too expensive.
mistakes: however 与 but 连用（*But however*）
however 后逗号位置错误
compare: however 较正式，but 更口语。
